slide2.title: ACQUISITION DETAILS
lines: Event date: 18 May 2026
Qualtrics acquired Press Ganey Forsta for $6.75 billion.
The acquisition expands Qualtrics’ experience management leadership in healthcare AI.
The deal creates the world’s largest AI dataset for human experiential context.
This acquisition is expected to enhance Qualtrics’ capabilities in the healthcare sector.
